title: I have submitted myself to You
cue: The last words before sleep, lying on the right side
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَهْبَةً وَرَغْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
transliteration: Allaahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wa'alja'tu zahree ilayk, rahbatan waraghbatan ilayk, laa malja'a walaa manjaa minka illaa ilayk, aamantu bikitaabika lladhee anzalt, wabinabiyyika lladhee arsalt
translation: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, entrusted my affair to You, and turned my back to You for support, in fear and in hope of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You sent down, and in Your Prophet whom You sent.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6311: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9461

provenance.note: We follow the printed al-Sultaniyya text of hadith 6311 on Shamela (أسلمت نفسي … رهبة ورغبة). Under the same number hadith-api gives أسلمت وجهي … رغبة ورهبة, the wording of another narration of this hadith.

usage.evidence: Make your ablution as for prayer, lie on your right side and say this; if you die, you die upon the natural way, so make these the last words you say. When al-Bara' repeated it back with "Your Messenger", the Prophet ﷺ said: no, "Your Prophet whom You sent" (al-Bukhari 6311).
